hook: Let's be honest... when did you last pray *Fajr* on time?
lesson_1: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
lesson_2: You can wake up. You've done harder things.
lesson_3: Missed it? Make tawbah, then *try again* tomorrow.
arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
todays_step: Put your Fajr alarm across the room tonight.
cta: Don't stop here. Follow for your next Jannah Level!
caption: Let's be honest... when did you last pray Fajr on time?
